claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM over 5 days, AZD7762 is expected to act primarily through CHK1/2 inhibition, causing S/G2 checkpoint abrogation and replication/DNA damage stress; as a single agent it is likely to be only weakly cytotoxic, with preferential killing of p53/G1-checkpoint-deficient cancer lines.
